title: Builder project registration - what buyers should verify before booking
p1:
A beautiful sample flat can hide a costly mistake.

Before paying a booking amount, many buyers check the location, price, and amenities — but miss one document that can decide the safety of their investment.
p2: A common misconception is that a builder's advertisement or brochure means the project is fully approved. The reality is that buyers should verify whether the project is properly registered and whether key approvals and details are available before committing money.
p3:
Project registration gives buyers access to important information about the development, including promised timelines, approvals, and builder commitments. A smart buyer checks the registration details, matches the promises with official records, and avoids relying only on sales conversations.

The best time to verify a project is before booking, not after problems begin.
